lede: The big one this week is Wednesday's Planning and Zoning hearing, where the Town's own Carhenge Redevelopment Project goes before the commission — a preliminary subdivision and concept review for a 15,000-plus square-foot parcel at 700 W Pacific Ave that could reshape that end of town. On the same day, SMART's board takes up two vendor contracts tied to the gondola structural analysis, which is as close to a make-or-break infrastructure decision as this valley sees. A special Town Council session Sunday adds a public hearing on a liquor permit for KOTO's Live at the Drive event.

notable.stake: Town-owned Carhenge site faces subdivision and concept review votes.
Two gondola structural-analysis contracts up for board approval.
Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive special-event liquor permit.
